review_provenance: Independent source-review message in the active Codex collaboration thread; this does not authenticate an external principal or authorize proof-impact changes.
scope: INV-012 and OBL-0104 through OBL-0106: named budget contracts, actual reducer and validator composition, production consumers, and limits stated in audit.md.
verdict: ready as a bounded correspondence audit; formal register entries remain in-progress
review_findings: The registered unfolding lemma alone is not the executable proof. Public BudgetLedger::transition and transition::apply bind actual production inputs/results through verified validation and command dispatch.
Conservation covers five dimensions; ledger_conserves uses an inequality, while available_is_exact establishes the exact equation including available capacity.
OBL-0105 wording requires an explicit overrun case: OverrunFaulted charges reserve minus prior observed, stores accounted observed at reserve, and retains larger cumulative usage as final_reported.
OBL-0106 names immediate-parent propagation. Actual recursive lineage charging supplies the finite path, but an explicit whole-path theorem/registered correspondence remains to be completed.
Durable CAS, observation authenticity, external resource usage and downstream getter/port correspondence remain separate work; no exclusion is justified by this checkpoint.
limits: Independent review checked named contracts and call sites, not every body of all 104 budget source files.
audit.md is preserved byte-for-byte at its original pre-review checkpoint and therefore retains its original review-pending statement; this record supplies the subsequent bounded review.
Source hashes cover the listed checkpoint files, not atomic compiler input custody or a clean committed candidate.
The review does not discharge an obligation, approve a proof-impact reduction, create an exclusion or change GitHub permissions.
